approval_required_for: Any architecture, pipeline, memory-layout, numeric-policy, tolerance, or major-template change; checkpoint, stimulus, target reference, testbench contract, exact wrapper, and source hashes are immutable.
Any ambiguous board or simulator target discovery, executable selection, or Vivado authority binding; require cited current evidence and bounded approval instead of guessing.

Any reopening of operator_leaf_modules or single_transformer_layer_kernel; it requires a current hash-bound direct core-boundary contradiction to a named certified invariant and an SACG-recorded backtrack.
Any promotion to synthesis, implementation, bitstream, runtime ABI, or board runtime before all required current board-layer gates and semantic/weight-consumption evidence pass.

consumes: current deterministic or real input stimulus provenance
current frozen numeric comparison policy and tolerance
Transformer-block-only model and tensor scope manifest
executable_actions.on_failure: Block all board simulation and classify the issue as a verification, checker, golden-reference, or loader/harness capability repair. Never generate expected outputs randomly, derive them from RTL, use an identity/default model, include model-tail tensors, or promote a partial manifest.
executable_actions.rationale: The current board scope lacks an accepted semantic loader/harness contract and executed complete-scope weight evidence. Generate expected outputs by running the real target model on the same immutable checkpoint and stimulus; a random generator may create inputs only. Restrict the catalog and binding requirements to Transformer blocks and preserve the current numeric policy without deriving or loosening tolerance from DUT output.

consumes: exact user-supplied sample-project wrapper and discovered simulation source closure
current live source hashes and identity document
current Vivado export facts and tool profile
executable_actions.on_failure: Do not run VCS, do not guess a target or executable, and do not consume the prior rejected identity or compile plan. If current Vivado evidence is ambiguous, stop for bounded approval rather than selecting names adaptively.
produces: current exact-wrapper and simulation-source hash manifest
executable_actions.rationale: Repair only the current board verification contract: bind the live exact sample-project wrapper and simulation sources to a new identity document, exact Vivado export facts, canonical VCS compile plan, ordered authority references, and an executable authorized by the current tool profile or cited export. This is a harness/authority repair, not an RTL or architecture change.

consumes: current immutable checkpoint and stimulus fingerprints
prior repair execution feedback and current_patch_application_feedback
executable_actions.on_failure: Record the planned_tool implementation gap and keep the board layer blocked. Do not reinterpret unattributed termination as a DUT defect, repeat the rejected unchanged replay, modify RTL, or reopen either certified lower layer.
executable_actions.rationale: The supplied repair execution identifies a missing capability: a diagnostically distinct capture that binds current source and stimulus hashes, preserves a replay fingerprint, distinguishes runner-owned termination from deterministic DUT/testbench or AXI/DDR failure, captures process provenance and terminal logs, and emits valid direct core-boundary evidence. The action must implement the planned tool capability before execution; it is not an unchanged-source replay and does not authorize an RTL edit.

consumes: current immutable checkpoint, stimulus, numeric policy, and exact wrapper/source hashes
executable_actions.on_failure: If evidence is missing, rerun the current-layer boundary trace rather than patching hardware. If termination remains external or unattributed, return to repair_step.03. If a deterministic trace supplies direct core start, ingress, egress, an earliest named causal boundary, and a current certificate contradiction, invoke repair_step.05; otherwise do not reopen lower layers and do not infer an RTL root cause from a frontier stall.
executable_actions.rationale: After the exact identity/authority contract and distinct provenance capture pass, rerun the same failed board layer with the current immutable checkpoint, stimulus, reference outputs, numeric contract, semantic testbench, complete weight-binding requirements, and exact wrapper. Collect direct core start, ingress, egress, lifecycle-frontier, data-order, liveness, and executed weight-consumption evidence before treating any functional result as a pass.

consumes: current VCS diagnosis and failure signature
certified lower-layer certificates and named invariant set
active SACG contamination barriers and current retry requests
executable_actions.on_failure: Do not apply an unlocalized or unbounded edit. If the trace does not name a direct contradiction, return to current-layer trace/provenance capture; if the proposed change affects architecture, pipeline semantics, memory layout, numeric policy, or a major template, stop for approval. After any bounded repair, rerun the same board layer before promotion.
executable_actions.rationale: This conditional action is executable only after repair_step.04 or a later current-layer rerun emits a hash-bound deterministic trace that localizes the earliest violated board integration, wrapper, scheduler, data-order, memory, or runtime contract. Repair only that causal slice. Do not patch a downstream output module merely because it is symptomatic, and do not alter checkpoint, stimulus, target reference, tolerance, testbench contract, exact wrapper identity, or accelerator scope.

consumes: current passing case_axi_ddr_interface and functional_sim evidence
exact user-supplied wrapper and current source identity/authority manifests
executable_actions.on_failure: Keep board_axi_ddr_wrapped_system at needs_repair, localize the earliest current-layer contract violation with trace/CCTG, and apply only a bounded repair followed by a same-layer rerun. Do not promote, synthesize, implement, generate a bitstream, or reopen lower layers without the required direct contradiction.
executable_actions.rationale: Only after the current VCS functional result and its complete semantic, numeric, order, liveness, and weight-consumption evidence pass, execute the remaining board-layer gates in dependency order. This closes multilayer behavior and the exact AXI/DDR wrapper; it does not authorize backend, bitstream, or board-runtime work until every required gate passes.

observations: The direct executed checker failure is case_axi_ddr_interface: the current source identity hash, identity document, Vivado-export compile authority, ordered-command authority references, and simulator executable authorization are not mutually bound. The diagnosis is historical-only because a live source hash changed and its layer/gate binding is invalid.

functional_sim is dependency-skipped rather than a deterministic DUT failure. Therefore there is no current board-level value, numeric, ordering, AXI, DDR, liveness, output-frontier, or executed complete-scope weight-consumption evidence.

The prior adaptive_semantic_stall is external_or_unattributed, source_semantic_repair_eligible is false, and the prior adaptive-observation transaction was rejected without edits. A simple unchanged-source replay or semantic reversal is not authorized; only a distinct provenance-capable capture may be executed.

The prior trace showing 1792 accepted ingress beats and zero accepted output beats is a lifecycle-frontier localization signal only. Independent AXI or prefetch progress is not output-frontier progress, and this trace does not provide the direct core start, ingress, egress, named causal boundary, and current-certificate contradiction required to reopen the connected kernel.

Operator-leaf and connected single-transformer-layer certificates are live and reusable. No current hash-bound trace contradicts them. Preserve their elastic variable-latency token-pipeline semantics, boundary order, and required cross-token overlap; do not impose strict same-cycle start/end behavior.

Before any board functional pass, require a complete target-checkpoint tensor catalog, deterministic or real input provenance, independent target-model inference outputs for that same checkpoint and input, the frozen numeric comparison policy, semantic testbench hashes, and executed proof that every required Transformer-block weight was consumed by the bound loader/harness. Existing files or manifests alone are insufficient.

The conditional specialist review was no_split and cannot replace deterministic checker evidence. Missing semantic evidence is a verification/golden-reference capability issue until real tools produce a localized value, order, liveness, or protocol failure.

SACG memory records active contamination barriers and six current open retry requests for this scope. The refined repair contract must not consume rejected artifacts as validated inputs and must return to Stage7 after bounded repair and rerun.
proposed_actions: Prepare and validate the immutable Transformer-block semantic contract using real target-model inference and complete tensor coverage requirements.
Rebuild and validate the current exact sample-project identity and canonical VCS compile authority from live Vivado export facts.
Implement and execute the required diagnostically distinct termination-provenance capture; do not repeat the rejected unchanged replay.
Rerun the failed board-layer VCS path with current boundary instrumentation and classify only current, hash-bound evidence.
If and only if a current direct core-boundary trace localizes a causal slice, apply a bounded current-layer repair and rerun it; otherwise keep lower layers closed.

After functional evidence passes, execute the remaining board-layer DAG for multilayer function, deadlock, AXI protocol, DDR roundtrip, semantic evidence, and weight-consumption closure. Do not promote to backend or board runtime until every required gate passes.
risks: Repairing an RTL output module based only on the ingress/output-frontier symptom could mask an authority, loader, lifecycle, AXI, DDR, or runtime-ABI defect.
A stale identity document, stale source hash, unauthorized simulator executable, or unbound Vivado export can create false simulation evidence and contaminate later gates.

Model, shape, data-order, numeric, memory, runtime, implementation, and board facts may diverge even if the VCS process exits successfully; all must remain bound to the same immutable checkpoint and stimulus.
Weight manifests do not prove DUT consumption. Missing complete-scope tensor hashes or loader/harness execution evidence must block functional acceptance.
Any change to checkpoint, stimulus, reference outputs, tolerance, testbench contract, exact wrapper/source hashes, or accelerator scope would invalidate the repair loop.
Repeated unattributed termination without new runner provenance would cause repair-loop spin; it must remain a verification-capability blocker rather than be reclassified as hardware failure.
Ambiguous board target or executable discovery must be resolved from cited current Vivado evidence or bounded approval, never by adaptive name guessing.

constraints: Active current-scope contamination barriers remain authoritative; rejected transition artifacts are planning/debug evidence only and cannot be consumed as validated inputs.
Open retry requests retry_request.0136, retry_request.0140, retry_request.0141, retry_request.0142, retry_request.0143, and retry_request.0144 remain open until a promoted Stage7 result exists.
No current-scope open backtrack request exists; do not infer one from omitted or global persisted counts.

Keep checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, numeric policy and tolerance, semantic testbench hashes, DUT weight-binding contract, exact wrapper, and exact board simulation source hashes immutable.
Use the exact user-supplied sample-project wrapper and discovered simulation sources; do not substitute a simplified wrapper or guess board, module, executable, or path names.
Transformer blocks are the complete accelerator scope; exclude embedding/tokenization, final norm, LM head/logits, sampling, and other model-tail work from DUT and weight-coverage boundaries.
Reopen a lower layer only for a current hash-bound trace that directly names a contradiction to a certified invariant.
edges: current sample-project source closure -> source identity document -> VCS compile plan
exact Vivado export facts and tool profile -> compile authority and ordered command authority references
immutable checkpoint and stimulus -> target-model reference outputs -> semantic testbench and numeric comparison
board VCS execution -> current boundary trace and weight-consumption evidence
current direct core-boundary contradiction -> possible targeted lower-layer backtrack
certified lower-layer evidence -> reusable board-layer input, but not board or backend readiness

output.summary: Do not promote the board_axi_ddr_wrapped_system layer or reopen certified lower layers. The authoritative current failure is a verification-capability and exact-board-contract failure at case_axi_ddr_interface; functional_sim and downstream board gates lack executable evidence. First restore immutable semantic and source-authority bindings, execute a diagnostically distinct termination-provenance capture, then rerun the same board layer in dependency order. No RTL root cause is currently justified.
